edges.reason: msg.sender identifies the locker and is the transferFrom payer in lock().
msg.sender selects the lock entry and is the recipient of unlock() transfers.
msg.sender is the payer and event admin in seedRewards().
msg.sender originates the owner address returned by owner() through _msgSender().
_msgSender() directly returns msg.sender.
block.timestamp determines the 30-day unlockTime stored by lock().
block.timestamp is the maturity condition authorizing unlock().
Local _unlockTime is derived from block.timestamp.
Parameter _amount is the value passed to token transferFrom in lock().
Parameter _amount is added to totalLockedBalance.
Parameter _amount is written into the locks mapping entry.
Local _unlockTime is stored in the locks mapping entry.
Increment operation mutates totalLockedBalance.
Decrement operation mutates totalLockedBalance.
Decrement operation mutates rewardsPool.
Increment operation mutates rewardsPool.
Cached _amount is subtracted from totalLockedBalance.
_rewards is subtracted from rewardsPool.
_totalValue is the amount sent out by the unlock transfer.
Principal _amount contributes to _totalValue.
Rewards _rewards contribute to _totalValue.
Parameter _amount feeds the (_amount * 40) / 100 computation.
Local _rewards is the result of the reward arithmetic.
_account indexes the locks mapping read by getLockedTokens().
_amount is the value pulled by seedRewards' transferFrom.
Attacker-supplied _tokenAddress determines which token is drained.
Queried _balance is the amount transferred out in withdrawLockedToken().
newOwner overwrites the privileged _owner state variable.
Constructor parameter initializes GasifyVaultAddress.
Constructor msgSender local becomes the initial _owner.
GasifyVaultAddress is the token called by lock's transferFrom.
GasifyVaultAddress is the token called by unlock's transfer.
GasifyVaultAddress is the token called by seedRewards' transferFrom.
GasifyVaultAddress is the default token observed by withdrawLockedToken.
lock() executes the external transferFrom call.
unlock() executes the external transfer call.
seedRewards() executes the external transferFrom call.
withdrawLockedToken() executes the external transfer call.
unlock() calls calculateRewards().
calculateRewards() performs the 40% reward multiplication and division.
lock() performs the totalLockedBalance increment.
unlock() performs the totalLockedBalance decrement.
unlock() performs the rewardsPool decrement.
seedRewards() performs the rewardsPool increment.
Only the owner can flip _isPaused to 1 through pause().
Only the owner can flip _isPaused back to 0 through unpause().
renounceOwnership() is owner-gated and writes _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership() is owner-gated and reassigns _owner.
Ownable constructor sets the initial privileged _owner.
GasifyVault constructor writes GasifyVaultAddress.
getLockedTokens() reads the locks mapping.
getTotalLockedBalance() reads totalLockedBalance.
lockStatus() reads the _isPaused flag.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
ERC20 transfer to msg.sender is an external call that could re-enter unlock(); state is cleared before the call so the exploit is mitigated.
withdrawLockedToken transfers the full token balance to owner(), which could be a contract callback into the vault.

normalization_plan.reason: Function-scoped parameter of lock(); absorbed by its owning core function node.
Local derived from block.timestamp inside lock(); has no standalone semantic role.
Local cache of locks[msg.sender].amount read inside unlock().
Local reward value produced by calculateRewards and consumed by unlock().
Local sum of principal and rewards only meaningful inside unlock().
Parameter feeding the reward formula; belongs to the calculateRewards node.
Return local of calculateRewards; no separate semantic identity.
Query parameter indexing the locks mapping inside getLockedTokens().
Owner-supplied seed amount consumed by seedRewards().
Token selector parameter that only matters within withdrawLockedToken().
Local balance read and immediately transferred out by withdrawLockedToken().
Parameter whose only role is overwriting _owner inside transferOwnership().
Local cache of _msgSender() used once to seed _owner during construction.
